Class ItemResources

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.item.ItemResources
public final class ItemResources extends Object
Items that hold resources (energy, a chemical, a fluid), seen as Items.ITEM resources in a machine's slots (D32). What an item holds comes from its ResourceItem behaviors; the amount lives in the item's data. The platform reads and writes it (setAccess(ItemResources.Access); on Paper, PaperItemResources); headless tests install their own.
